stem:
Janet has 2 new games.

• Each game has 3 packs of cards.
• Each pack has 10 cards.

Which model can be used to find the total number of cards Janet has for these 2 games?
visual_elements: model F: two rows of three boxes each containing 10
model G: two rows of three boxes each containing 3
model H: two rows of two boxes each containing 3 and 10
model J: two rows of one box each containing 10
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding of multiplication and representing the total number of cards by combining groups and packs across two games.
